<a id="TextureResourceResolver-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(Object input)` 

If `true`, the input is an [`ITexture`](/reference/bridges/itexture/).

<a id="TextureResourceResolver-method-resolve"></a>

### resolve

`Resource resolve(ResourceBuilder builder, Object input)` 

Returns the resource that shows the texture as it is, without decoding; the same texture gives the same resource while it lives.
